content: Dr. Michalina Drejza serves as a Clinical Assistant Professor at the University of Michigan in Ann Arbor, Michigan, USA, specializing in obstetrics and gynecology. She is also the Director of Research and Development at the International Youth Alliance for Family Planning (IYAFP) in Poznań, Poland, with a focus on youth-related reproductive health. Joanna Erdman is an Associate Professor specializing in health law and policy at the Schulich School of Law, Dalhousie University, Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada. Her expertise lies in the intersection of law and reproductive health policy. Dr. Kristina Gemzell Danielsson is the Head of the Department of Women’s and Children’s Health at the Karolinska Institutet in Stockholm, Sweden. Her work focuses on obstetrics, gynecology, and abortion research. Dr. Caitlin Gerdts is the Vice President for Research at Ibis Reproductive Health in Oakland, California, USA, with expertise in qualitative research methods. Dr. Laura Gil is a practicing clinician based in Bogotá, Colombia, with a focus on clinical reproductive health. Dr. Selma Hajri is the Founder and President of the Tawhida Group for Research and Action on Women’s Health in Tunis, Tunisia. Her expertise includes abortion, contraception, and reproductive health research. Dr. Guyo Jaldesa is an Associate Professor of Obstetrics and Gynecology at the University of Nairobi in Kenya, specializing in reproductive health. Dr. Godfrey Kangaude is a Postdoctoral Researcher at the University of Pretoria and a Reproductive and Sexual Health Law Fellow at the University of Toronto. Based in Blantyre, Malawi, his expertise includes sexual and reproductive health rights law. Dr. Vinoj Manning is the Chief Executive Officer of the Ipas Development Foundation in New Delhi, India, with a focus on health systems in South-East Asia. Dr. Hiromi Obara, a medical doctor, serves as Deputy Director of the Division of Global Health Policy and Research at the National Center for Global Health and Medicine in Tokyo, Japan. She is also a Project Coordinator for the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) in Cambodia, specializing in health systems in the Western Pacific region. Dr. Alongkone Phengsavanh is the Vice Dean of the Faculty of Medicine at the University of Health Sciences in Vientiane, Lao People’s Democratic Republic. His expertise includes obstetrics, gynecology, and abortion care. Dr. Akila Radhakrishnan is the President of the Global Justice Center in New York, USA, with expertise in law and policy related to reproductive health. Dr. Michelle Remme is the Research Lead at the United Nations University’s International Institute for Global Health in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Her work focuses on research, gender, and health system financing. Dr. Chi Chi Undie is a Senior Associate at the Population Council in Nairobi, Kenya, with expertise in abortion, contraception, and policy. Christina Zampas is the Associate Director of Global Advocacy at the Center for Reproductive Rights in Geneva, Switzerland, specializing in human rights. Dr. Patricia Lohr is the Medical Director of the British Pregnancy Advisory Service (BPAS) in London, United Kingdom, and a member of the Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists (RCOG). She also advises the Making Abortion Safe Programme. Dr. Jaydeep Tank is the Secretary General of the Federation of Obstetrics and Gynaecological Societies of India (FOGSI) and Chair of the International Federation of Obstetrics and Gynecology (FIGO) Working Group for Safe Abortion, based in Mumbai, India. Dr. Francelle Toedtli is a consultant with the United Nations Population Fund (UNFPA) in New York, USA. Ann Yates is the Lead Midwife Adviser at the International Confederation of Midwives (ICM), headquartered in The Hague, Netherlands. Dr. Jeppé Schroll is a Consultant, Research Coordinator, and Associate Professor in the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology at Amager Hvidovre Hospital in Copenhagen, Denmark. Dr. Nicholas Henschke and Dr. Gemma Villanueva are Senior Systematic Reviewers, while Dr. Yanina Sguassero is a systematic review expert with Cochrane Response, focusing on evidence synthesis for reproductive health. Dr. Maria Rodriguez is an Associate Professor of Obstetrics and Gynecology at Oregon Health & Science University (OHSU) in Portland, Oregon, USA, contributing to law and policy recommendations in reproductive health. Dr. Safia Ahsan, based in Washington, D.C., USA, works with the Reproductive Health Supplies Coalition at PATH, specializing in market development and supply chain management. Dr. Traci Baird, also based in Washington, D.C., is a leader in women’s health and sexual and reproductive health at EngenderHealth. Dr. Sharon Cameron is affiliated with Chalmers Hospital in Edinburgh, United Kingdom, and specializes in obstetrics, gynecology, abortion, contraception, and genital tract infections. Dr. Jane Harries leads the Women’s Health Research Unit at the University of Cape Town, South Africa, focusing on abortion, contraception, and reproductive health research. Dr. Thoai Ngo is a researcher at the Population Council in New York, USA, with expertise in health policy. Dr. Mariana Romero is affiliated with the Centre for the Study of State and Society (CEDES) in Buenos Aires, Argentina, specializing in maternal health, abortion, and research. Dr. Rachel Simon-Kumar is a faculty member at the University of Auckland and the Centre for Asian Health Research and Evaluation (CAHRE) in New Zealand, focusing on social science, gender, and economics. Dr. Beverly Winikoff is associated with the Gynuity Health Project in New York, USA, with expertise in reproductive choice, contraception, abortion, and women’s health. Dr. Rasha Dabash, Dr. Rebecca Wilkins, and Dr. Bethan Cobley are external partners providing feedback on reproductive health guidelines, representing Ipas, IPPF, and MSI Reproductive Choices, respectively. Dr. Mekdes Feyssa and Dr. Bela Ganatra are key members of the WHO Steering Group, focusing on abortion and contraception. Dr. Roopan Gill and Dr. Antonella Lavelanet contribute expertise in humanitarian settings, law, and policy. Dr. Moazzam Ali and Dr. Ian Askew are part of the WHO Secretariat, contributing to sexual and reproductive health research and policy development.
